name: Tel Aviv · Jaffa
tagline: Beaches, Bauhaus and an ancient port
summary: A beach city of white Bauhaus buildings, cafés and nightlife, joined to the ancient port of Jaffa. Check current travel advice before planning.
seasonNote: Summers are hot and humid; beaches are warm from May to October. Shops and transport largely stop on the Sabbath.
arrival: Ben Gurion Airport is 20 km away; trains reach the centre in 15 minutes.
gettingAround: Walk or cycle (Tel-O-Fun bikes); the light rail and buses cover the rest.
foodTip: Sabich, shakshuka, hummus and modern Israeli restaurants; Carmel Market for street food.
buyTip: Design shops in Neve Tzedek and the Jaffa flea market.
baseArea: Near the beach between Gordon and Frishman, or Neve Tzedek

connections.note: Fast trains; not on the Sabbath.

items.name: Old Jaffa
items.summary: One of the world's oldest ports, with a stone old town, a clock tower and a flea market.
items.expect: Hilly lanes; the flea market is busiest on Fridays.
items.tip: Walk the beach promenade from Tel Aviv to Jaffa at sunset.

items.name: Tel Aviv beaches and promenade
items.summary: A 14 km sandy coastline with lifeguards, beach bars and matkot paddle-ball players.
items.expect: Lifeguards from May to October; strong currents on red-flag days.
items.tip: Gordon and Frishman beaches for a classic day; Hilton Beach is surfers' and gay-friendly.
